SlurmClusterTest.pins: the job framework in Slurm cluster mode (parseCluster=true): tasks are submitted with sbatch, polled with squeue, retried with more CPUs and cancelled at the end. These tests submit real jobs, so they only run when PETAKIT5D_TEST_SLURM_CONFIG is set (Linux and macOS only):

deskewRotateWrapperRunsAsJobs.pins: a data wrapper end to end on the cluster gives the same result as the in-memory function

failedTaskIsRetriedWithMoreCPUs.pins: a job that ends without its output is resubmitted (after a grace period) with cpusPerTask * (trial + 1) CPUs, up to maxTrialNum

finalOutputCancelsRemainingJobs.pins: once the final output exists, the framework returns and cancels the jobs still running (it used to return before the scancel, leaving them running)

finalOutputEndsTheRun.pins: the first task writes the final output; the others would run for minutes, but the framework stops once the final output exists

jobStatusFollowsSqueue.pins: check_batch_slurm_jobs_status parses the default squeue output

masterComputesPartOfTheTasks.pins: with masterCompute the MATLAB session runs a batch itself instead of waiting for its job

matlabTasksRunAsJobs.pins: jobs start MATLAB with MatlabLaunchStr, run setup.m from the repository root and then the task string
